tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Lists coverage (US states, US federal sector rules, countries), the date the data was last checked, and related Nero Labs Rules servers. Free.

tools.name: who_to_notify
tools.description: Works out every data breach notice a company owes and the deadline for each. Give affected (how many people in each US state or country), the data types exposed (for example ssn, drivers_license, payment_card, financial_account, medical, health_insurance, username_password, biometric, passport, dob,

tools.name: list_breach_laws
tools.description: Lists breach notification laws with who is covered, which data types trigger them, encryption exemptions, every notice with its deadline rule and threshold, penalties and the official source. Filter by US state, country (ISO code or name) or scope (us_state, us_federal_sector, country, region). Free

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "who_to_notify" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Works out every data breach notice a company owes and the deadline for each. Give affected (how many people in each US state or country), the data types exposed…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_breach_laws · Public sink: who_to_notify.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_breach_laws · Public sink: who_to_notify

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
